chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil narrated to us. He said: Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt from Ali b. Musa al-Rida from his father from his forefathers from Amir al-Mu'mineen, peace be upon them.

He said: The Messenger of Allah said: Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said: "Whoever interprets My words by his own opinion has not believed in Me. Whoever likens Me to My creation has not recognized Me. Whoever utilizes qiyas in My religion is not upon My religion."

key_terms.تشبيه: tashbih - anthropomorphism, likening God to creation
key_terms.تفسير بالرأي: interpretation by personal opinion - heretical exegesis
key_terms.قياس: qiyas - analogical reasoning rejected in Shia jurisprudence

ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about interpreting the Quran by personal opinion?
ai.summary: A Hadith Qudsi transmitted through a chain from Imam al-Rida through his forefathers from Imam Ali, from the Prophet, from Allah: God declares that whoever interprets His words by personal opinion has not truly believed, whoever likens Him to His creation has not recognized Him, and whoever uses analogical reasoning (qiyas) in His religion is not truly upon His religion. This hadith was part of the seventh-century Amali lecture sessions, reminding the audience of the absolute authority of divine revelation over human conjecture.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim b. Hashim narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from al-Rayyan b. al-Salt from `Ali b. Musa al-Rida from his father from his forefathers from Amir al-Mu’mineen (as).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: Allah said: “Whoever interprets My words by his own opinion has not believed in Me. Whoever likens me to My creation has not recognized Me. Whoever utilizes qiyas in My religion is not upon My religion.”
